paite: Noumau leh Laodisia a omte leh sa a ka mel mu lou peuhmahte a ding in bangchibang a thupi in ahia noute a dia ka kisuk na theih uh ka ut hi.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

paite: Pathian thuguk atheihtheih ua, theihsiamna theihchetna kim hauhna tengteng lam a, phankhawm a a-om ua, alungtangte uh lungmuang a a-omtheihna ding un;
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

paite: pilna leh theihna gou chiteng amah Khrist ah selguk in a-om hi.
english: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

paite: Kuamah in paukam siam a ahon khemzohlouhna ding un, huaite ka gen ahi.
english: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

paite: Sa in na kiang uah om kei mah leng, kipaktak a om in na kizendan uleh Khrist ginna a na kipdan uh thei in, kha in na kiang uah ka om hi.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu, Toupa na kipahpih bang un, amah ah om un.
heading: Khrist A Hinna
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

paite: Amah a zungkai leh lamtouh a om in, ahon zilsak bang un na ginna ua kiptak a om in, kipahthu genna hau in amah ah om un.
english: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

paite: Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in Khrist thu hilou, mihing thugousiah leh khovel thubulte bang in athupil uh leh khemna peuh in gallak in ahon la kha ding uhi.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

paite: Amah ah Pathian taangchinna chiteng tuh pumpi nei in a-om gige hi.
english: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

paite: Amah ah hinna taangchinna na neita ngal ua; amah vaihawmna leh thuneihna tengteng lutang ahi.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

paite: Amah ah zeksum, mihing khut a sum hilou, Khrist in abawl zeksumna ah na pianken khelhna uh suahkhia in zeksum na hita uhi.
english: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

paite: Baptisma a amah toh vui na hita ua, huai mah ah misi lak a kipan a Pathian nasep gintak ziak in amah toh kaihthoh na hi uhi.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

paite: Huan noute na tatleknate uleh na sa uh zeksumlouhna a si na hi ua, noumau ngei amah toh ahon hingsak in na tatlekna tengteng uh angaidamta hi.
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

paite: I tatlekna tengteng hon ngaidam a, batna lai thupiak a gelh i tung ua om eimah hon dou gige anulmangta hi. Huai ngei kros a kilhlum in alamangta hi.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

paite: Vaihawmna leh thuneihnate suankhia in, huaite kros a zou in alangtang in theihsakna in azangta hi.
english: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

paite: Huchi in nek-le-dawn thu ah hiam, ankuanglui leh kha thak thu ah leh Sabbath ni tan thu ah kuamah in hon dem kei hen.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

paite: Huaite thil hong tung ding lim ahi a, atak zaw Khrist ahi.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

paite: Kuamah in amau deih thu lel a thunuailutna leh angel biakna zang in, athil muhte uh pansan in, asalam lungsim ziak ua kisathei mawkmawk in, na kipahman uh hon suhsak kei hen.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

paite: Lutang len tinten lou in a-om uhi. Amah a kipan in pumpi apum in aguhtuah leh thaguite a vak leh zopkhawm a om in, Pathian khansak bang zel in akhang hi.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

paite: Khovel thubulte Khrist kiang a na sihsan uleh, bang achia khovel a khosa bang a thupiakte lak a na kipelut na hi ua?
heading: Khovel Thubulte Sihsanna
english: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

paite: Lawng ke'n, chiam ke'n, khoih ke'n, chihte,
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

paite: mihingte thuchiam leh zilsakna huchibang thil tengteng zat kawm a mangthang ding hilou uhiam?
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

paite: Hiai thilte bawltawm biakna leh thunuailutna tak lou leh pumpi kisukgentheihna ah zaw hihtuak hileh akilawm na a, himahleh sa deihlam zuih khamna ah bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
english: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
